terrain_type: Coastal plain and rocky desert. Division positioned 12 miles inland from Sidi Barrani at reserve position.
seasonal_impacts: Moderate rainfall begins in November-December (20-30mm monthly). Improved operating conditions compared to summer heat, but cold nights challenged troops with inadequate winter clothing. Better tank and vehicle mobility in cooler temperatures.
environmental_challenges: Water scarcity remained critical despite cooler temperatures. Extended supply lines from Tripoli (over 1200km) via inadequate coastal road. British naval supremacy prevented sea resupply. Dust and sand continued to damage weapons and vehicles. Poor drainage in fortified positions during rain.
